items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-08-23
items.q: No, that's George Washington. George Washington. George Figo.

ctx.x: What about, do you remember George Figo? You remember George?
No, that's George Washington. George Washington. George Figo.

He was a trombone player and he was around Chicago. He was with King Oliver for a while. I didn't even need him. I didn't need him. What about George Washington? What kind of a trombone player was he?
